.thermal-receipt{width:74mm;max-width:74mm;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:11px;color:#000;margin:0;padding:0}.receipt-header{text-align:center;margin-bottom:6px}.brand-logo-slot:empty{display:none}.receipt-logo{max-height:38px;max-width:55mm;margin-bottom:4px}.shop-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;margin-top:2px}.shop-info{font-size:9.5px;line-height:1.35;margin-top:2px}.receipt-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;margin-top:5px;text-transform:uppercase}.receipt-info{font-size:10px;line-height:1.45}.receipt-info div,.summary-row,.payment-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}.receipt-info span{font-weight:600}.receipt-info 0}.grand-total{font-size:14px;font-weight:900;padding:4px 0}.section-title{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:3px;text-transform:uppercase}.tax-line{font-size:9px;line-height:1.35;padding:2px 0;border-bottom:1px dotted
